scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:hospital: pnpm --filter @workspace/krispoint run db:migrate:hospital && VITE_KRISPOINT_EDITION=hospital VOICE_CLIENT_TOKEN="${SESSION_SECRET}-hospital-voice" pnpm --filter @workspace/krispoint run dev
scripts.build:solo: node scripts/run-solo.mjs build && node scripts/package-solo-backend.mjs && node scripts/package-solo-voice.mjs
scripts.test:voice: node --test scripts/tests/voice-ticket.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s vosk-server/tests -p 'test_*.py'
